name: pulse
reportsTo: Pulse server on the sink (HTTP push every 30 s)
footnotes: The agent talks to the Pulse server over the bed's private network (10.0.0.0/24) in plain HTTP: the agent refuses an http:// server URL unless the host is loopback or a private address, and the sink has no TLS hostname. The installer it fetches from the server is checksum-pinned.
